derivation: neuter of a compound of a derivative of G906 (βάλλω) (used for the comparative of G18 (ἀγαθός));

occurrences.text: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
